summary: Require an obtainable cargo landing pad for modern rocket-return science.
details: Modern rocket-return acquisition now requires an obtainable cargo landing pad with positive inventory capacity. Silo, construction and receiver must share a surface witness; permission to launch without a pad cannot prove acquisition of the return.

Receiver unlocks join the same dependency tree used by science frontiers, self-lock rejection and contextual reuse. Independent receivers and alternate unlocks remain usable; changed receiver recipes invalidate warmed acquisition.

Controlled LAUNCH01-LAUNCH29 cases exercise the canonical solver and consumed science prerequisite service. Current-package native launch, production and saved-world qualification remain pending under A04.
